name: Nightstars
storyline:
"After such a long day of work, a quick nap wouldn't hurt... would it?"
Your name is Jacob Williams and you work as a watchman at the local "Nightstar Palace" restaurant.
After oversleeping on the job, you find yourself locked inside the place for the rest of the night.
You will be forced to survive the night while defending yourself against a group of animatronic animals wandering the establishment during the late hours, using any equipment at your disposal.
Whatever happens, do NOT leave your room until the night is over, it's not safe.
Will you make it out alive?
summary:
Nightstars is a Five Nights at Freddy's fan-game developed by Bonzee & Co.

It's a short one night game focusing on reaction times and prioritisation skills. Expect some twists, fresh mechanics and more!
